title: Components are the design unit: every piece is a composable component with one job, declared inputs and outputs and a schema, assembled by config
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:33Z: 'Components are our best friend, that's why react is dope as fuck. Keep this in mind and use as a design principle moving forward.' Binding: scripts, pages, seats and watchers are components (CMP nodes) with explicit interfaces (IFC nodes) and no shared hidden state; a page is built from components the way the board's stations are; reuse before writing.
